# jwt

Types from the Go package `jwt` (a library PocketBase builds on), as JavaScript sees them: they turn up as values of [PocketBase's types](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and of hook events.

## jwt.MapClaims

MapClaims is a claims type that uses the map[string]any for JSON
decoding. This is the default claims type if you don't supply one

Has everything <code>{ [key: string]: any }</code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `getExpirationTime()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/jwt#jwtnumericdate">NumericDate</a>)</code> | GetExpirationTime implements the Claims interface. |
| `getNotBefore()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/jwt#jwtnumericdate">NumericDate</a>)</code> | GetNotBefore implements the Claims interface. |
| `getIssuedAt()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/jwt#jwtnumericdate">NumericDate</a>)</code> | GetIssuedAt implements the Claims interface. |
| `getAudience()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/jwt#jwtclaimstrings">ClaimStrings</a></code> | GetAudience implements the Claims interface. |
| `getIssuer()` | <code>(): string</code> | GetIssuer implements the Claims interface. |
| `getSubject()` | <code>(): string</code> | GetSubject implements the Claims interface. |

## jwt.NumericDate

Has everything <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timetime">time.Time</a></code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `marshalJSON()` | <code>(): string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;</code> | MarshalJSON is an implementation of the json.RawMessage interface and serializes the UNIX epoch represented in NumericDate to a byte array, using the precision specified in TimePrecision. |
| `unmarshalJSON()` | <code>(b: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;): void</code> | UnmarshalJSON is an implementation of the json.RawMessage interface and deserializes a [`NumericDate`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/jwt#jwtnumericdate) from a JSON representation, i.e. a `json.number`. This number represents an UNIX epoch with either integer or non-integer seconds. |

## jwt.ClaimStrings

ClaimStrings is basically just a slice of strings, but it can be either
serialized from a string array or just a string. This type is necessary,
since the "aud" claim can either be a single string or an array.

Has everything <code>Array&lt;string&gt;</code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `unmarshalJSON()` | <code>(data: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;): void</code> |  |
| `marshalJSON()` | <code>(): string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;</code> |  |
